annotations.title: Resolve a job to MCP servers (signed)

description: Use this when you need an MCP server for a job and want a signed, expiring answer you can verify: returns up to 10 servers that answered at their last check, each with a stable ID, its address, its status, when it was checked and an Ed25519 signature (JWS) valid for 48 hours. The keys are at https://7it.co.il/.well-known/capability-resolver. It never connects you to a server; your client decides. No charge.

max_ms.description: Only servers whose handshake took at most this long

need.description: The job in plain words, for example "send a transactional email"

no_sign_in.description: Only servers that answered without sign-in

payment.description: none = only servers that declare no payment

read_only.description: Only servers with a read-only tool for the job

name: resolve
title: Resolve a job to MCP servers (signed)
